description:
Audit and remove unreachable retired REQ ceremony implementation remaining in tools/sdlc/src/sdlc.py and obsolete-only tests or command helpers. Establish actual imports, callers, wrappers, and safety dependencies before deleting code. Current item-engine safety_cli.py imports this module for package/image safeguards; old direct CLI already rejects retired commands. Remove only proven-unused workflow states, plan/task/round orchestration, and legacy dispatch surfaces. Keep or separate shared safety functions with simplest justified design; no wholesale safety-engine deletion or unnecessary rewrite. Preserve source-hash, architecture, package ownership/overlap, upgrade, whole-tree payload/metadata/xattr restoration, cleanup, lock, quarantine, and recovery checks plus their meaningful regression coverage. Keep historical transcript import support, REQ ledger/history, retired snapshots, package artifacts, and hardware evidence. Acceptance: active LETS item/chain workflow and safety commands retain behavior; retired ceremonies remain inaccessible; relevant unit/system/safety regressions pass with no weakened safety evidence. No image/HW action, dependency installation, quarantine recovery, or kernel-module changes authorized by intake.

Migration-chain prerequisite: consume ITM-0005 disposition/reference report before removing any function potentially required by retained recovery evidence or live image-safety tooling. Record import/caller/command ownership and keep required recovery functionality available despite obsolete REQ workflow removal. This item independently proves its active safety interfaces and regressions before completion; ITM-0003 documents those finished interfaces and ITM-0006 consumes their verified result. No module-input import, compiler prerequisite fix, or actual reset-module build belongs here.

Latest artifact-ownership ruling: All these folders belong to the planning, implementation and QA stage and should be managed under .codex/sdlc as in Specz (with claude). Consume ITM-0005 report via its immutable managed-artifact locator. Publish all planning/implementation/QA audit deliverables through the tested ITM-0002 artifact tooling under .codex/sdlc. Historical contracts/evidence relocations and path mapping belong to ITM-0002; ITM-0003 supplies historical/current index. Do not remove protected image state or immutable bundle payloads while pruning retired source. Preserve every original safety/consumer/regression obligation.
